subject: SOC2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence cadence, retention change, capacity bump
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence cadence, retention change, capacity bump

Team —

Acme's renewal is active and procurement asked us to surface a concrete SOC 2 re-attestation workback plus a proposed capacity uplift for evidence transfer windows. Key asks from Acme: 1) confirm retention horizon change (they want 540d for audit logs vs our standard 365d for this account), 2) provide a staged evidence handoff plan with signed links and audit mapping, and 3) a short-term burst of Dedicated capacity to absorb parallel exports and customer validation traffic during the recert window.

I sketched a minimal plan below. Please reply with owners and ETA for each line item.

- Evidence index (CSV) mapping log types -> time ranges -> s3 prefix (owner: Jonas?) — due 2026-11-06
- Retention change PRD + legal clause language (owner: Kimberly) — draft due 2026-11-05
- S3 staging playbook: how we produce signed links, rotate KMS-wrapped keys, hashes for integrity (owner: Ben) — due 2026-11-06
- Capacity uplift proposal: dedicated pool +2 nodes and 30-day burst windows + cost delta (owner: Lukas) — due 2026-11-06

Attachments: acme-evidence-index.csv (placeholder), retention-change-diff.pdf (redline vs standard), s3-staging-playbook.md (template).

Notes: Acme wants the retention change to be explicit in the renewal amendment (they will sign on DocuSign). Procurement also asked for an explicit on-ramp schedule for the Dedicated capacity so finance can model cost-of-good-sold for Q1.

Thanks — please flag any blockers.

Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence cadence, retention change, capacity bump

On 2026-11-02 09:12, Lukas Meyer wrote:
> Team —
>
> Acme's renewal is active and procurement asked us to surface a concrete SOC 2 re-attestation workback plus a proposed capacity uplift for evidence transfer windows.

Thanks for the outline. I can take the evidence index and produce a mapping that splits artifacts into three buckets: (A) system audit logs (auth, admin actions), (B) request/trace logs (ingress/egress), (C) archival artifacts (backups, snapshots). Plan:

- I will run a quick inventory against our logging pipeline and estimate raw object sizes for the 540d window; preliminary estimate is ~18 TB of raw logs, ~3.5 TB compressed indexes. I'll validate with infra tomorrow.
- For the handoff we should produce per-bucket manifests (newline-delimited JSON) and then a single signed manifest CSV (attached as acme-evidence-index.csv).
- Staging path proposal: s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2026-11-recert/ with lifecycle to expire after 90 days. Access via time-limited presigned URLs and KMS-wrapped envelope keys; include SHA256 checksums next to each object in the manifest.

Cost/ops note: A short 30-day dedicated bump (+2 nodes) should cover parallel ingest/export and customer validation sessions; estimated incremental infra cost ~ $18k for the 30-day window. We can offer a 50% usage credit to help close the renewal if leadership approves.

Attached: preliminary manifest (acme-evidence-index.csv) and a short S3 staging playbook (s3-staging-playbook.md).

I'll own the manifests and the initial size estimate.

— Jonas
Senior Security Engineer

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novaops.com>
To: Lucas Meyer <lukas.ruiz@redwood.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-payments.com, Daniel Park <daniel@finova.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence cadence, retention change, capacity bump

Lukas / Jonas —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from Acme's security and procurement teams:

1) Retention: Acme's auditors require 540d for auth and admin audit trails, 365d is acceptable for request traces. We will need a short paragraph in the amendment calling out the per-log retention windows and an operational note about exports for legal review.

2) Keying / integrity: We require logs to be exported with a KMS envelope key that we control (we can share a rotated key ARN) OR we require a signed hash manifest for each object. The latter is easier on your side but less ideal for our security team.

3) Burst capacity: Procurement is ok with a 30-day burst but they need a firm cost cap. If you include a capped uplift commitment (e.g., +2 nodes, not to exceed $20k incremental) that works for legal/finance.

4) Timeline: Procurement needs the amendment and DocuSign package by 2026-11-10 to keep the renewal on the current loop.

I'll start the DocuSign amendment draft (I attached amendment-docusign.pdf) and can accept either KMS integration or signed manifests. If you go with signed manifests, include the hashing algorithm and signing key details.

— Marta Ruiz
Head of Security Programs, Acme Payments
Marta.Ruiz@novaops.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novaops.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-04T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence cadence, retention change, capacity bump

Marta —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick confirmation and owners so procurement can proceed:

- Retention language: I will draft amendment clause language that lists 540d for auth/admin logs and 365d for request traces; will include an operational note about periodic exports. (owner: Kimberly — draft 2026-11-05)
- KMS vs signed manifests: Jonas will provide signed-manifest option with SHA256 + signer identity; if Acme prefers KMS envelope integration we will scope an integration task but it will push timelines by ~5 business days. (owner: Jonas)
- Capacity uplift: Lukas will finalize +2 nodes, cost cap $20k for 30-day burst; we will include a 50% usage credit as commercial concession for this renewal (owner: Lukas).
- Evidence handoff: Jonas to produce per-bucket manifests and final CSV; Ben to provide the automation script we will run to generate presigned URLs and rotate temporary keys. (owners: Jonas, Ben)

Mutual action plan (high level):
1) 2026-11-05: Redwood provides amendment draft + evidence index (Kimberly + Jonas)
2) 2026-11-06: Redwood publishes S3 staging manifest and cost uplift estimate (Jonas + Lukas)
3) 2026-11-09: Acme reviews DocuSign and returns redlines
4) 2026-11-10: Target DocuSign sign and amendment execution

Deal reference: ACME-4892. I'll update the renewal/opportunity record and add the amendment PDF and our draft clause into the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleEvidenceMap

Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
